title: Blockworks: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common Blockworks failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a base becomes confusing, reduce the palette. Use one floor color for movement, one wall language for safety, and one marked service lane for machines.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If a base becomes visually noisy, reduce the palette and re-mark the essentials: entrance, exit, storage, power, machines, and danger.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
